name: rust-eze-sdk-platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,UI -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @upp/api" "npm run dev -w @upp/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run sync:date-format && npm run build -w @upp/sdk && npm run build -w @upp/plugin-mysql && npm run build -w @upp/plugin-storage && npm run build -w @upp/plugin-notifications && npm run build -w @upp/api && npm run build -w @upp/dashboard

author: Harold Paulino
description: Rust-eze: TypeScript Universal Plugin SDK, Fastify REST + GraphQL APIs, React dashboard, MySQL and macOS HTTPS demo.
